subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot keep the current one-message-per-safe-Markdown-chunk behavior, or merge chunks into one QQ bubble when the combined payload fits a verified safe byte limit?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves complete Markdown chunks, an open PR proposes merging safe chunks, and a member comment says splitting is by design; automation cannot choose that permanent user-visible channel policy.

options.title: Preserve intentional split delivery
options.body: Treat the current complete-chunk behavior as QQBot policy, document or explain the limit tradeoff, and close this issue plus the linked merge PR after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Land bounded safe merging
options.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032 or an equivalent patch that merges only verified-safe chunks and preserves overflow splitting.

recommendation.title: Preserve intentional split delivery
recommendation.body: Treat the current complete-chunk behavior as QQBot policy, document or explain the limit tradeoff, and close this issue plus the linked merge PR after maintainer confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp owns the recent QQBot Markdown chunking history and provided the current by-design policy signal.
